svg.title: A model can propose a tool action; the application decides whether it may run
svg.desc: The application verifies the current caller and scopes retrieved evidence before a model sees it. Retrieved text and the model's proposed tool, target and amount remain untrusted. An application-owned gate independently checks the current caller and tenant, allowed tool and exact target, a separate trusted request for the exact job and amount, exact approval with revision and expiry, an action limit, and a stable operation identity. A failed check denies the action with no fictional effect. An allowed action records one fictional effect, receipt and audit decision; replay returns the earlier receipt. The local lab uses trusted fixtures and an in-memory effect, with no actual model, human authentication, payment or AWS call.
svg.text: A model proposes; the app decides
Fictional credit example: reading is not authority to act.
Tool, target and amount may be wrong or hostile.
1 · Actor, tenant, allowed tool + exact target
Prompt text cannot supply any of these grants.
Local fixture only: no model, real sign-in, payment,
